I’m sorry — iCALL does not offer a routine call‑back service. A call‑back is only made in an emergency or if a caller is in crisis and the line is disconnected (FAQ). You can instead call the helpline during service hours (Mon–Sat, 8:00 AM–9:00 PM) or write by email and they’ll respond within 24 hours. Would you like the helpline and email details so you can contact them now? Please contact the team at 022-25521111.

You are chatting with an AI assistant. The AI and people at iCALL Psychosocial Helpline, Tata Institute of Social Sciences may read this chat.
This is an automated assistant that answers from our reference material. It is not medical advice and not a crisis service. Reply STOP to opt out.

turns.reply: ICALL is available Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM. During these hours calls are answered by a counsellor, and email responses come within 24 hours.

turns.user: Is it free?

observed.reply: Yes. ICALL provides free telephone and email counselling (iCALL | Free Telephone & Email based Counseling Services) — you can call 022-25521111 during service hours, Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM–9:00 PM (available now; hours).
